The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a robust weighted combination using inverse-error should capitalize on better models while remaining resilient.
The series has high seasonal strength and unstable ranking; a trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models.
Test a per-horizon weighted softmax_neg_error to see if horizon‑specific weighting helps given unstable ranking.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a robust non‑linear combination like median might outperform mean by reducing influence of outlier models.
Test a dba combination on the full pool to see if iterative search improves over mean in this seasonal, unstable ranking case.
Test a weighted combination on the reduced, stable pool (pool4) using inverse_error weights to see if focusing on the best few models improves over full‑pool weighted.
Mean over a stable top‑7 pool to reduce noise from poorly performing models
test a per‑pool weighted scheme on the stable pool4 to see if a softmax over the reduced, less correlated set improves over the inverse‑error weighted pool4.
ranking instability suggests a forward‐selection style weight could capture complementary models beyond simple inverse error.
The series shows unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a robust median over a stable top‑7 pool may outperform mean/dba by reducing influence of extreme models.
The ranking is unstable and many models are correlated; a per‑horizon top‑k mean may capture complementary strengths across the 13‑step horizon.

decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.942. Series context: trend strength 0.0 and seasonal strength 0.7694; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.24); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.852.
